claims.statement: GET /health/live remains an exact typed process signal and never resolves or invokes readiness, so a missing, failed, or throwing readiness dependency cannot turn liveness into a database, catalog, registry, or startup check.

GET /health/ready recomputes six fixed ordered internal checks and returns the same typed no-store projection for both outcomes: 200 only when every check is ready and 503 when any represented check is not ready. OpenAPI declares the shared 200 and 503 schema.

An absent or malformed probe, a probe exception containing private database, credential, or path text, and a bounded probe timeout all yield deterministic typed 503 output with stable codes, no raw cause, and Cache-Control no-store rather than a 500 or cached fallback.

The local probe checks existing database connectivity plus mapped worker columns, types, defaults, keys, constraints, and indexes without creating or changing the SQLite file; compiles exact 5/12/36/43 catalog metadata; and validates deterministic registries without invoking them. Missing migration-head and persisted-seed verification remain explicitly not ready.

limitations: API-01 verifies the health transport and read-only fail-closed aggregation boundary. DEL-04 still owns Alembic revisions, deployed-head verification, catalog projection tables, transactional seeding, and database-versus-source catalog parity; current mapped-table compatibility is not described as migration currency.

Until DEL-04 supplies migration-head and persisted-catalog parity checks, the default local probe truthfully reports those checks not ready. A fully composed injected probe can exercise the documented 200 response without weakening the default.
The response proves one instantaneous set of internal checks. It is not proof of continuous availability, successful worker execution, or external provider and connector reachability.
Readiness does not migrate, seed, repair, create a digest key, call a model provider or connector, or perform an external-network probe.
File-backed SQLite is exercised. PostgreSQL runtime readiness, migration parity, and contention are not exercised.
Worker process health, scheduler polling and metrics, Compose health checks, and startup ordering remain Plan 15 and DEL-05 scope.
